privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy – Woods Etna Chalet
privacyPolicy.intro: This website, dedicated to Woods Etna Chalet, is for informational purposes only and does not directly collect personal data from users.

sections.heading: 2. Data Collected Automatically
sections.content0: During browsing, some data may be collected automatically in an anonymous and aggregated form, such as:
sections.content2: • Type of device and browser used
sections.content4: These data are used only for technical and security purposes and do not allow user identification.

subsections.content: The site integrates a map via Google Maps iframe to show the location of the property. Google may set essential technical cookies to ensure the proper functioning of the service. For more information: Google Privacy Policy.
The site uses an external service (Supabase) to display the already booked dates of the chalet. Access is read-only via anon key and does not involve the collection of personal data from the user.

subsections.subheading: c) External links to social media and contacts
subsections.content: The site may include buttons or links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, or other external services. By clicking these links, the user is redirected outside the site and data processing follows the respective service's privacy policies.

By clicking the WhatsApp button, the user can contact the property directly via the WhatsApp application. The management of message data is subject to WhatsApp/Meta privacy policy: WhatsApp Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies
sections.content: The site uses only essential technical cookies necessary for the operation of the site and the above services. Profiling or tracking cookies are not used. Therefore, prior user consent is not required.

sections.heading: 5. User Rights
sections.content: Users can contact the data controller at the email address above to request clarifications or exercise the rights provided by Articles 15-22 of the GDPR (access, deletion, restriction, etc.).
